scope: Existing protobuf decoder compiled natively in isolation; six native XCTest boundary methods and independent raw golden-byte checks. No actual provider, authority, portable-platform, release or all-substrate acceptance claim.

redToGreen.reusablePrimitive: Bounded wire decoding before arithmetic, shifting or allocation.
redToGreen.thinnestProviderLayer: None; repair the existing shared decoder.
redToGreen.testEvidence: Exact old native length subprocess traps; old overwide-varint subprocess incorrectly accepts. Both fixed probes and their separate rerun reject. Six isolated XCTest methods pass, and independent golden-byte review preserves UInt64.max while rejecting 254 overflowing tenth bytes.
redToGreen.otherSubstrateBenefit: No additional substrate benefit demonstrated. gRPC reflection and unary paths share the repaired decoder; wider reuse is an architectural possibility, not an acceptance claim.
